functions.name: GetKeyPositions
functions.docs:
Retrieve all key positions stored in this buffered curve
@param OutKeyPositions         Array to receive key positions, one per index of InKeys

functions.name: GetKeyAttributes
functions.docs:
Retrieve all key attributes stored in this buffered curve
@param OutAttributes         Array to receive key attributes, one per index of InKeys

functions.name: GetLongDisplayName
functions.docs: Returns the full/long display name of the curves. Buffered curves can only be applied to the original curve it was stored from.

functions.name: GetValueMin
functions.docs: returns the lowest output value in curve space for this buffered curve

functions.name: GetValueMax
functions.docs: returns the highest output value in curve space for this buffered curve
